description: Tell WhatsDownNow that your agent or app hit an error talking to a tracked service. Use this when you see 5xx, timeouts, or rate limits, even if our status page still says up — reports from 6+ independent networks within 30 minutes are flagged as an 'Unverified agent-report spike' (it never changes the official/probe verdict). Fields: service (slug or name), error_type (5xx, timeout, rate_limit, auth, network, other), optional model and region. Rate-limited and deduplicated per network. Also counts toward user-report alert thresholds.

detail.description: Optional short note (no secrets or personal data)

model.description: Model id if known, e.g. gpt-4.1 or claude-sonnet-4

region.description: Region or endpoint if known, e.g. us-east-1

service.description: Service slug or common name, e.g. chatgpt, anthropic, aws

name: report_issue
title: Report an error you hit
